concept.title: Map validation checklist
concept.shortdesc: When creating a book map or a DITA map, you should meet the following criteria:

conbody.p:
When creating a book map or a DITA map, you should meet the following criteria:
Every .dita file in the project is referenced by at least one map
No topic appears twice at the same level without a reason
Concept topics precede task topics at the same hierarchy level
Reference and troubleshooting topics appear after task topics
Glossary topics are collected under a topicgroup or backmatter
